values: A rebid against current per-acre rates lowers the annual cost.
Bundling related design work and benchmarking fees against FDOT norms lowers the fees.
Buying at the county's paving unit prices, or bidding together, costs less than buying alone.

datasets.title: Shared-owner campaign gifts
datasets.description: Businesses that share an officer, manager or registered agent (state corporate records) and gave to the same local candidate, one row per business. Only groups checked by hand are listed. People are not named. Each company is its own contributor under Florida law, so a group is legal when each company is a real contributor.

datasets.title: Gifts over the contribution limit
datasets.description: Organizations that gave one local candidate more than Florida's $1,000-per-election limit, as the campaign reported it (s. 106.08, F.S.), net of reported refunds. The primary and general are separate elections. Each case was checked by hand. status is Open (over the limit as reported, no explanation found) or Resolved (resolution says why: a reporting error, an amended report, a refund, a check designated for the general election, or a Florida Elections Commission ruling). A reported overage is not a finding of wrongdoing. Individual donors are not listed.

datasets.description: Businesses that local nonprofit board members run, from Florida corporate filings (Sunbiz officers and registered agents), with each business's gifts to local campaigns. match is "Name and address" when the person on the nonprofit's own state filing is the same Sunbiz person, or "Name" when only one Sunbiz person in the county has that name. person_id matches nonprofit-board-members.

datasets.title: Nonprofits: Florida charity registrations
datasets.description: Charities with a county address registered with the Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services to ask the public for donations (Check-A-Charity): registration status and dates, the revenue and the program, fundraising and management spending each reported to the state, and the professional fundraising firms it uses. nonprofit_id links to the nonprofits dataset (joined by FEIN, then by exact name); the officers and directors each registration lists are in nonprofit-board-members.

datasets.title: Officials on nonprofit boards
datasets.description: Elected officials, department leaders and candidates listed as an officer or director of a local nonprofit in its IRS returns or state corporate filings. Only matches checked by hand are listed.

datasets.title: Officials' businesses
datasets.description: Registered businesses (Florida Division of Corporations) that list an elected official, department leader or local candidate as an officer, manager or registered agent, with the filing date and status. Each official-to-record match was checked by hand. Only officials and candidates are named.

datasets.title: Officials' business ties
datasets.description: How officials' and candidates' registered businesses connect to public life: two officials on the same business, an official's business giving to a campaign, a donor business that shares an officer with a candidate's business (the shared person is counted, not named), and an official's business paid by a local government. Published only for hand-checked matches.

datasets.title: Campaign gifts from business owners
datasets.description: Personal gifts to local campaigns from people who run a registered Florida business, one row per person and campaign. A contributor filed as an individual is listed when the name and street address on the Supervisor of Elections filing are the same as an officer, manager or registered agent of a for-profit business on Sunbiz that was active around the gift; middle initials and Jr/Sr must agree, and protected voters are never matched. Other individual donors are never named. No addresses or occupations.

columns.name: match
values: same name and street address as a Sunbiz officer, manager or registered agent

datasets.title: Profiles: people, companies and organizations
datasets.description: Every company, elected official, candidate, nonprofit, nonprofit board member, registered business, committee and government named in BayCounty.me records, one row each, with its profile page and how many documented connections it has. entity_id (kind:key) joins entity-connections. Board members are named as their nonprofits' public filings list them; individual campaign donors are included only when they run a registered business (owner-gifts).

datasets.title: Connections between people, companies and organizations
datasets.description: Every documented connection between two entities in entity-profiles, totalled per pair and kind: a government paid a payee, an organization gave to an official's or candidate's campaign, an official voted on a company's contracts, a person sits on a nonprofit's board or runs a business, a nonprofit gave a grant, two payees share a project. Each row has its source. Individual campaign donors are included only when they run a registered business (owner-gifts); officials' board seats and businesses are added by the API once checked by hand.

columns.name: relation_label
values: shares a project or address with

datasets.title: Site menu
datasets.description: Every link in the site's main menu, one row per link, in English and Spanish: the section and the question it answers, the link's place in the section, and the section's start-here page. place_id is the place the menu belongs to (fl-bay = Bay County), so a menu for another place sits beside it.

datasets.title: Checkbook: every payment
datasets.description: Every payment in each government's own check register (checks, ACH, wires and cards), as published from the files the government sends: date, payee, amount, check number, invoice, fund, account and description. fiscal_year is the year the fiscal year ends. Voided checks are left out. Payments to private individuals (refunds, reimbursements) are listed as "Individual (name withheld)" with payee_kind individual and a category instead of the description. payee_entity_id links a payee to its profile (entity-profiles) when the site knows it. Bank statements and reconciliations are never published.

datasets.title: Budget vs. actual, month by month
datasets.description: Each government's budget-vs-actual report as of each month end (as_of), line by line: fund, department, account, the original and amended budget, actual_ytd (spending, or revenue collected, to date) and encumbered (open purchase orders). line_type is expense or revenue. One report per month end, so a fiscal year has a row per line per report. fiscal_year is the year the fiscal year ends (FY2026 = Oct 2025 to Sep 2026).

datasets.title: CRAs: tax increment by agency
datasets.description: One row per Community Redevelopment Agency that collects tax increment in Bay County: when it was created, its base year, the FY2025 increment and how much of it Bay County and the city paid, the total on record, its sunset date and what that date rests on, and the increment still to come under a 3%, 6% or 9% growth scenario. sunset_assumed is true where the CRA's plan was not found.

columns.name: sunset_basis
values: All four districts are scheduled to sunset in 2044 (2025 plan). Bay County keeps 26% of the increment from the 2025 St. Andrews expansion area (not modeled).
Extended from about 2033 to Nov 30, 2043 by Res. 2026-01-504 (Jan 2026).

No end date found. Projected to Sept 30, 2039, the latest date under s.163.3755, F.S. for a CRA that existed in 2019 unless the city votes to continue it. The increment is passed to the Pier Park Community Development District under the 2001 partnership agreement.

Plan extended from 2031 to 2049 by Res. 19-140 (Sept 2019). A 2024 city-county agreement caps yearly CRA revenue at $30M through 2049; a 2020 agreement (Res. 20-85) rebates 20% of county increment above $15M a year to the county.
The plan text was not retrieved. Assumes the 30-year plan limit (about 2034). No positive increment before FY2024.
The plan text was not retrieved. Assumes the 30-year plan limit (about 2037); Sept 30, 2039 at the latest under s.163.3755, F.S. unless the city votes to continue it.

datasets.title: CRAs: tax increment by year
datasets.description: Property tax paid to each CRA by fiscal year, split between Bay County and the city by millage. scenario history: basis reported (from CRA reports, audits and budgets) or filled gap (between two reported years). scenario low, mid, high: FY2026 to the CRA's sunset, from adopted budgets where they exist, then 3%, 6% or 9% growth a year (Front Beach Road capped at $30M). Schools and the water management district are exempt and pay nothing.

datasets.title: CRAs: estimate checked against official figures
datasets.description: Official county figures for CRA payments next to this estimate for the same year, with the difference in percent.

datasets.title: Tax districts
datasets.description: Which taxing authorities levy property tax in each tax district, and the combined millage. Rates by year are in property-tax-rates (authority_id).
